scope: Incremental EndSpellConcentration native initial assessment and six requested extraction files. Read-only static review, including finite preceding policy gates and immediate helper leaves. purityReview.result: No forbidden read-time call found in this finite native admission path.
details: EnterRead consumes the established current condition projection. This path does not call ConditionsFor, Restore, AdvanceTo, ResolveCore, ResolveCastingUtility, BeginSanctuaryGate, a replay, reserve, RNG, or a candidate validator.
WorldOpening leaves are actor/activity membership and exact schedule selection. WorldTiming.ForActor returns existing epoch records; it does not reconstruct a calendar.
ClericLongRestProfile.Active and PendingSanctuary select retained current records only.
PendingCalendarChoice reads pending records. PendingMove and PendingCommandStepOffer are SingleOrDefault selectors; CurrentPressOffer is an ordered selector, not normalization or invalidation.
ManufacturingChoicePending and HasPendingRecoveryOffer are status predicates. The effect check is a finite Any over retained SpellEffects.

Core RequiredInventoryOwners reaches its empty-owner result for a shape-valid End command; this adds no inventory right. This conclusion is specific to End, not a general review of other inventory-claim branches.

New RequireExecution instrumentation at Initial, AdvanceTo, ResolveCore, ValidateState, and ReplayReceipt returns immediately outside a read inspection; it guards execution-only entry points rather than executing them during this assessment.

remainingQualificationObligations: Keep CommitFeasibility unset until the actual post-resolution effects and all relevant predictable capacities/validation constraints are established by pure source-derived facts. Do not call the resolver or validator to obtain that answer.

Do not count hunting-trigger queuing as a demonstrated End blocker: QueueCompletedTacticalHuntingTrapEntries selects newly resolved movement/push records at s.Revision+1, while EndSpellEffect only replaces the selected effect. Reachability must be established before adding a constraint.
The immediate EndSpellEffect replacement does not itself append SpellCasts, CastingActivities, or a new SpellEffect; this narrow observation does not certify the rest of the transaction.

Core Execute still performs authoritative candidate shape/policy validation or verified checkpoint processing, with original rollback behavior. Those remain execution stages; new public result/obligation mapping and complete capacity qualification are not approved here.
